d: Monster High: Ghouls Rule unearths an old conflict between "Normies" and monsters - and things are about to get scary! For years  students at Monster High were warned that Halloween was a night to stay inside and avoid conflict at all costs.
S6:E1 Episode 1 - Dodgeskull | Home Ick | Scare-born Infection | No Place Like Nome
Draculaura has a fright idea when her dad lectures her class on human holidays!

S4:E2 Episode 2 - Queen of the Scammed | Friday the 13th | Fear Amid Power | Hoodoo You Like | Fear Pressure | Fear the Book | Desperate Hours | Missinfearmation | Hyde and Shriek | Daydream of the Dead | Nefera Again | RBack to Ghoul | Abominable Impression | Frost Friends | Hyde Your Heart
S1:E4 Dozens of Cousins - Bree has her hands full when Twist's many bunny cousins come to visit.

S1:E10 Garden Ghouls - The Ghoul Squad receives a call for help fromTreesa Thrornwillow, whose sister is plotting to destroy the Haunted Garden where they both live. The ghouls must take flight with new butterfly wings to stop Tressa's sister and save the garden.
S1:E18 Snowball Effect - Polly competes in her first Gold in the Cold Fest! But when her efforts are sabotaged, she'll need Grandma's help to make it to the finish line.

S1:E12 The Damaged Spellbook - When Chelsea discovers that Otto has torn a page in a cookbook that he borrowed, she goes to Dreamtopia, where the Apprentice Queens perform an opposite spell that mysteriously goes haywire because Notto Prince covered up the fact that he tore a page from their spell book.
S4:E22 Apple Puppin' - During an autumn apple picking outing, Polly and Pierce rescue a stray dog.
S6:E5 A Little Inspiration - After Eva sees a negative comment on her dance solo, Polly and friends try to help her find inspiration so she can make her solo something everyone will love!
Polly and her friends head off to Rio de Janeiro where they find a lost cat that belongs to a Brazilian dancer and then embark on a tropical journey to reunite the cat with its owner.

It's a new school year at Monster High, and the little sister of Clawdeen Wolf, Howleen, is determined to be more fangtastic than ever. Her dream of popularity turns out to be easier than anyone imagined when she stumbles upon a genie named Gigi Grant who grants her not 3, but 13 wishes!
